guidance: Field definitions describe recorded meanings, not new evidence or approval. Schemas use strings for imprecise or qualified dates rather than inventing ISO precision.

sources.access_date: Reported source-inspection date; not an independently attested capture timestamp.
sources.authors: Recorded authors. Preserve the source value and its enclosing record context.
sources.id: Stable Commons identifier. Identifiers are not reused for unrelated records.
sources.independence_group: Existing source-family grouping. Versions, announcements, companion outputs and common data may be dependent.
sources.issuing_body: Recorded issuing body. Preserve the source value and its enclosing record context.
sources.locator: Recorded locator. Preserve the source value and its enclosing record context.
sources.preservation: Recorded source-copy status. A null hash is no claim that original bytes were captured.
sources.publication_date: Publisher date of the recorded version; may be null, year-only or qualified text. Never infer observation period from it.
sources.publication_record: AI preparation, standing publication authority, individual-human-review state and decision date; not source verification.
sources.publisher: Recorded publisher. Preserve the source value and its enclosing record context.
sources.source_kind: Recorded source kind. Preserve the source value and its enclosing record context.
sources.title: Recorded title. Preserve the source value and its enclosing record context.
sources.url: For a source: original publication locator. For a term: retained founding source citation. Neither is necessarily a Commons webpage.
sources.verification: Status and scope of source inspection, authenticity assessment, corroboration and dispute checks; these are separate judgments.
sources.version_note: Recorded version note. Preserve the source value and its enclosing record context.

cases.event_date: Reported grouping interval/context. Cases include studies and conceptual settings; this is not necessarily a precise event date.
cases.event_date_precision: Recorded precision/qualification for the grouping date.
cases.id: Stable Commons identifier. Identifiers are not reused for unrelated records.
cases.kind: Recorded kind. Preserve the source value and its enclosing record context.
cases.publication_record: AI preparation, standing publication authority, individual-human-review state and decision date; not source verification.
cases.source_ids: Direct citations for the evidence or case record. Bundle sources may also include dependency endpoints that are not additional direct citations.
cases.summary: Recorded summary. Preserve the source value and its enclosing record context.
cases.title: Recorded title. Preserve the source value and its enclosing record context.

evidence.case_id: Stable identifier of the published study, series, incident or operational grouping.
evidence.dispute_status: Recorded qualification/dispute assessment, not systematic clearance.
evidence.evidence_standing: Detailed reporting assessment with attribution and scope; historical wording is retained in private version history when corrected.
evidence.evidence_standing_label: Controlled reporting category; separate from glossary claim standing and publication permission.
evidence.glossary_fit: Scope/fit assessment; a relationship does not validate a definition.
evidence.id: Stable Commons identifier. Identifiers are not reused for unrelated records.
evidence.keywords: Recorded keywords. Preserve the source value and its enclosing record context.
evidence.limitations: Scope, uncertainty and contrary conditions that must accompany the finding.
evidence.observation: Attributed source finding. It may include context; it is not an independently verified Commons fact.
evidence.open_questions: Recorded open questions. Preserve the source value and its enclosing record context.
evidence.publication_record: AI preparation, standing publication authority, individual-human-review state and decision date; not source verification.
evidence.publication_status: Recorded publication status. Preserve the source value and its enclosing record context.
evidence.source_ids: Direct citations for the evidence or case record. Bundle sources may also include dependency endpoints that are not additional direct citations.
evidence.source_locations: Source ID to inspected supporting section/page/location as recorded; not proof of independent reproduction.
evidence.support_assessment: Commons assessment/interpretation, distinct from the source finding.
evidence.title: Recorded title. Preserve the source value and its enclosing record context.
evidence.verification_status: Whether underlying claims are independently verified by the Commons.

terms.baseline: Recorded baseline. Preserve the source value and its enclosing record context.
terms.blob_sha: Recorded blob sha. Preserve the source value and its enclosing record context.
terms.claim: Founding glossary descriptive claim standing; absent for normative entries rather than inferred.
terms.definition: Recorded definition. Preserve the source value and its enclosing record context.
terms.id: Stable Commons identifier. Identifiers are not reused for unrelated records.
terms.name: Recorded name. Preserve the source value and its enclosing record context.
terms.publication_record: AI preparation, standing publication authority, individual-human-review state and decision date; not source verification.
terms.url: For a source: original publication locator. For a term: retained founding source citation. Neither is necessarily a Commons webpage.
terms.vocabulary: Founding vocabulary standing, separate from evidence strength.

relationships.explanation: Recorded explanation. Preserve the source value and its enclosing record context.
relationships.from_id: Origin endpoint of an explicit evidence-to-term, evidence-to-evidence or source-to-source relationship.
relationships.id: Stable Commons identifier. Identifiers are not reused for unrelated records.
relationships.publication_record: AI preparation, standing publication authority, individual-human-review state and decision date; not source verification.
relationships.relationship_type: Recorded relationship type. Preserve the source value and its enclosing record context.
relationships.to_id: Destination endpoint of the relationship; its meaning is given by relationship_type and explanation.

withdrawals.date: Recorded date. Preserve the source value and its enclosing record context.
withdrawals.id: Stable Commons identifier. Identifiers are not reused for unrelated records.
withdrawals.reason: Recorded reason. Preserve the source value and its enclosing record context.
withdrawals.status: Recorded status. Preserve the source value and its enclosing record context.
